entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Peterson, and the order number is VF88602.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order pulled up here. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?
They just don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after any ride longer than an hour. They're just not working out for me.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort; getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks for waiting. I see here that you received the shoes 56 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the window.
Oh, that's great news. So I can get a full refund?
That's correct. We can process a full refund for the item once we receive it back. I can email you a prepaid shipping label right now.

Excellent. I appreciate you making that easy. Now, since I did have to deal with the hassle and the painful blisters, and I'll have to find another pair, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I understand your position, Mark. While I am not able to add a discount code to this return, I can assure you the full refund for the cycling shoes will be processed promptly and your return shipping is completely covered.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is what matters most. Please go ahead and send that label to my email on file.

Of course. I've just sent the email with the return label and instructions. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mark. Have a great day!
